title: The Fastest Sled in Town
lines: Meg said, "My sled is the fastest."
They went up the tallest hill by a tree.
Meg went fast. Nick went faster.
Then a brown dog slid past on a lid.
Meg had to grin. That dog is the fastest!

questions.ask: Who slid past Meg and Nick on the hill?
questions.listenFor: The brown dog, on a lid. It is right there in the story - if your child guesses, have them reread that line instead of being told.

questions.ask: What did Meg and Nick each say about their own sled?
questions.listenFor: Each one said his or her sled was the quickest. Listen for the compare words - fastest, faster.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg was cross at the end? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story - the grin, or the dog beating them both.
